lore.common: Takes every photo at the exact moment someone blinks.
lore.uncommon: Makes everyone lean in and squash together just to fit in the picture.
lore.rare: Flashed so brightly at the party that everyone saw purple spots for ten minutes.
lore.epic: Flashed at the exact moment the wedding cake was cut, and the whole wedding album came out as one big white blur with a fork in it.
lore.legendary: Took a group photo so wide that it fitted the whole town in, and now every house in town gets a copy every New Year, including the bakery.

lore.common: Collects a fingerprint smudge right in the middle every single time.
lore.uncommon: Twists in and out with a satisfying whirr whenever you zoom.
lore.rare: Zooms in on the one thing nobody wants to see, like the spot on your nose, in perfect, crystal-clear detail.
lore.epic: Zoomed in on a hawk from the other side of the valley, and the hawk looked surprised.
lore.legendary: Took a photo of a hedgehog so sharp that everyone who looked at it said ouch and checked their fingers.

lore.common: Makes the whole cast wait while it's set up for one tiny shot.
lore.uncommon: Uses up a whole reel of film on one scene.
lore.rare: Shouts CUT in the director's voice at random, so the actors keep freezing halfway through a sneeze.
lore.epic: Filmed a chase across the whole city, and the traffic stopped to watch.
lore.legendary: Filmed one scene for so long that the actors grew real beards, and the sequel had to begin with a shave.

lore.common: Needs winding after every photo, and you always forget.
lore.uncommon: Only takes twenty-four photos before it needs a new roll.
lore.rare: Swaps its film with someone else's at the shop, so the family album now has a stranger riding a camel in it.
lore.epic: Took a whole roll on the summer holiday, and the family waited two weeks to see them.
lore.legendary: Took a photo so old-fashioned that everyone in it came out in black and white, including the brand-new red car.

lore.common: Makes everyone shake the photo even though they're not supposed to.
lore.uncommon: Spits out a little square picture with a whirr.
lore.rare: Prints what people were thinking instead of what they looked like, so the party photos are mostly cake.
lore.epic: Printed a hundred photos at the party, and the fridge door ran out of space.
lore.legendary: Printed a photo so fast that it came out before the picture was taken, and everyone had to copy their own poses.

lore.common: Gets left on, so every photo comes out completely black.
lore.uncommon: Dangles on a little string and bonks against the camera.
lore.rare: Vanished into a pocket, a handbag and a sofa all in one afternoon.
lore.epic: Popped off at the top of the mountain and rolled all the way down, and the whole hiking group chased it into the cafe.
lore.legendary: Stayed on through a whole solar eclipse, so its owner is the only person with no eclipse photos and perfectly safe eyes.

lore.common: Runs out of battery just before the big moment.
lore.uncommon: Wobbles so much that every video makes you feel seasick.
lore.rare: Records everything in fast-forward, so Grandma's birthday speech lasts four seconds and sounds like a mouse.
lore.epic: Filmed the whole school play with the lens cap on, so the cast had to perform it again in the living room.
lore.legendary: Recorded a birthday party on a tape so long that it also caught the next ten birthdays and the dog's first swim.

lore.common: Ignores the remote until you stand right in front of it.
lore.uncommon: Is so thin that you can see it from the side and think it's gone.
lore.rare: Switches to the cooking channel whenever anyone is hungry, so dinner is late every single night.
lore.epic: Showed a penalty kick so realistically that the whole living room dived for the ball, and the sofa never recovered.
lore.legendary: Showed a fireplace video so convincingly that the cat sleeps in front of it and the heating bill went down.

lore.common: Starts a giant update the moment you want to play.
lore.uncommon: Has a controller that drifts left all on its own.
lore.rare: Crashed at the exact moment its player was about to win.
lore.epic: Started an update during the sleepover that lasted so long the guests went home, grew up and came back to play.
lore.legendary: Paused a game so hard that the whole house paused too, and Dad is still standing in the hall with one sock on.

lore.common: Has a strap that bumps against your chest on every step.
lore.uncommon: Is held the wrong way round by everyone the first time, making everything tiny.
lore.rare: Makes everything look so close that its owner keeps ducking whenever a bird flies past a mile away.
lore.epic: Was lent to a short-sighted owl at the nature reserve, and the owl has refused to give them back ever since.
lore.legendary: Looked so far into the distance that it saw all the way round the world to the back of its owner's own head.

lore.common: Blinks all night so brightly that the nearby houses never get dark.
lore.uncommon: Bobs on a buoy at sea and blinks a pattern to the passing boats.
lore.rare: Flashes in a pattern that seagulls cannot resist, so the harbour fills with confused birds every evening.
lore.epic: Flashed so hard into the storm that the clouds blinked first and went home early.
lore.legendary: Shone so far out to sea that a whale followed it into the harbour and asked where to park.

lore.common: Loops the same beat over and over until everyone has it stuck in their head.
lore.uncommon: Has rubber pads that get pounded by fingers all day.
lore.rare: Speeds up a tiny bit every bar, so every song ends with the band sprinting.
lore.epic: Got stuck on one beat at the wedding, and the guests had to dance until the caretaker found the plug.
lore.legendary: Played a beat so catchy that the washing machine, the kettle and the dog all learned it by teatime.

lore.common: Wheezes like an old dog whenever someone pumps its bellows.
lore.uncommon: Plays one long drone note that hums through the floorboards.
lore.rare: Breathes in so hard that it sucks the sheet music off the stand, and sometimes the curtains.
lore.epic: Hummed through the village hall concert so loudly that the windows buzzed.
lore.legendary: Played one note so long that a whole cow fell asleep standing up, then the farmer, then the tractor.

lore.common: Hangs round its player's neck and knocks over the microphone stand.
lore.uncommon: Has bright neon keys that glow under the stage lights.
lore.rare: Makes whoever wears it play every song twice as fast, including the slow one at the wedding.
lore.epic: Played a solo so long that the drummer went home, made tea and came back for the ending.
lore.legendary: Hit a note so high that only bats could hear it, and the bats asked for an encore.

lore.common: Has a thousand sliders, and someone always moves the wrong one.
lore.uncommon: Has a sea of buttons that blink like a spaceship.
lore.rare: Turns up whoever is singing worst, so every concert stars the dad at the back.
lore.epic: Had one slider nudged by a passing goose, and the festival field heard nothing but bass for an hour.
lore.legendary: Mixed a concert so perfectly that the echo came back a week later to say well done.

lore.common: Scratches the record whenever someone walks past too heavily.
lore.uncommon: Crackles before every song like it's clearing its throat.
lore.rare: Plays every record a little too fast, so every singer sounds like a squirrel in a hurry.
lore.epic: Played a record backwards at the family party, and every guest walked home in reverse.
lore.legendary: Played a record so old that the singer on it phoned up to ask for a copy.

lore.common: Bleeps and bloops on every preset except the one you want.
lore.uncommon: Has a button that makes every note sound like a dog barking.
lore.rare: Turns every note into a different animal, so the wedding march came out as a duck, a goat and a sea lion.
lore.epic: Played every sound effect at the school concert, from thunder to a cow.
lore.legendary: Made a thunder sound so real that the weather forecast changed, and the town brought umbrellas to the beach.

lore.common: Scratches back and forth so much that the record gets a headache.
lore.uncommon: Has a crossfader that slides from one song to the next.
lore.rare: Spins any record it touches at disco speed, including the lullaby, so the baby now breakdances.
lore.epic: Spun so fast at the school disco that the whole hall turned round, and everyone left by the wrong door.
lore.legendary: Scratched a record so hard that it carved a brand-new song into it, and the band had to learn it.

lore.common: Collects dead moths in its shade that nobody wants to clean.
lore.uncommon: Flickers for a second every time you switch it on.
lore.rare: Switches itself off the second anyone sits down, and back on the moment they stand up to check.
lore.epic: Lit up the whole dinner party so brightly that nobody noticed the burnt pudding.
lore.legendary: Shone so brightly through the night that the neighbour's rooster crowed at midnight for a month.

lore.common: Clinks its crystals together every time someone slams a door.
lore.uncommon: Collects dust on every single prism, and takes all day to clean.
lore.rare: Turns every crystal into a tiny mirror, so nobody at dinner can pull a face behind their napkin.
lore.epic: Sparkled over the grand ball so brightly that the dancers wore sunglasses.
lore.legendary: Rang its crystals so sweetly during a storm that the thunder stopped to listen and moved next door.

lore.common: Buzzes quietly from one bulb that never quite works.
lore.uncommon: Sways gently when someone walks across the floor above.
lore.rare: Has candle-shaped bulbs that look real until you try to blow them out.
lore.epic: Dimmed and brightened over the whole restaurant during the proposal, and the room gasped.
lore.legendary: Dimmed itself so romantically at an anniversary dinner that Grandad proposed to Grandma again, and she said maybe.

lore.common: Bends its neck so that it shines in your eyes instead of on the page.
lore.uncommon: Gets so warm over the homework that the cat sleeps on the maths book every evening.
lore.rare: Bends round to read over your shoulder, and tuts at every spelling mistake.
lore.epic: Shone on the homework so hard that the answers faded off the page, and the whole class had a very good excuse.
lore.legendary: Stretched its neck so far that it reached the street lamp outside, and now the whole road does homework under it.

lore.common: Is so tall that it hits the ceiling when moved.
lore.uncommon: Has a cord that trips everyone walking past.
lore.rare: Leans over whoever sits in the armchair, so every visitor feels like they're being interviewed.
lore.epic: Fell over at the party and lit up the ceiling, so the guests spent all night doing shadow puppets on it.
lore.legendary: Stood so still in the corner that the family mistook it for Grandad and knitted it a cardigan.

lore.common: Stands on three spindly legs and topples whenever a dog runs past.
lore.uncommon: Casts a shadow behind everyone in the photo.
lore.rare: Lights everyone from below at the worst moment, so the wedding photos look like a ghost story.
lore.epic: Toppled over in the middle of the fashion shoot, and the model's surprised face started a whole new fashion.
lore.legendary: Stretched its three legs so tall that it lit the whole town from above, and the pigeons complained about the glare.

lore.common: Hangs so low that everyone bonks their head on it.
lore.uncommon: Swings like a pendulum every time someone sneezes, and the family sets their watches by it.
lore.rare: Shines only on the plate of whoever is last to finish their vegetables.
lore.epic: Swung so low at the kitchen party that it dipped into the punch bowl and turned everyone's drinks orange.
lore.legendary: Hung so low for so long that the kitchen table grew up to meet it, and now dinner is eaten standing.

lore.common: Clips onto the book and keeps slipping off the page.
lore.uncommon: Glows so softly that it puts its reader to sleep.
lore.rare: Lit a whole book under the duvet without anyone noticing.
lore.epic: Clipped onto the wrong book at bedtime, so Dad read the whole family a car manual in his best dragon voice.
lore.legendary: Read so many books by itself after lights out that it now does all the voices better than Dad.

lore.common: Leaves a little ring of light in your eyes in every photo.
lore.uncommon: Makes faces so smooth that Grandad's video call came back without his eyebrows.
lore.rare: Switches on so brightly in a dark room that the houseplants turn to face it and the curtains open by themselves.
lore.epic: Was the only light on in the street during a power cut, so the whole street queued for passport photos.
lore.legendary: Made a cake look so perfect on camera that the cake started believing it and refused to be eaten.

lore.common: Gets so hot that everyone under it starts sweating.
lore.uncommon: Has a big soft box that makes everyone look gentle.
lore.rare: Spotlighted the star so perfectly that everyone else disappeared.
lore.epic: Got so hot during a live cooking show that it baked the presenter's bread before the oven did.
lore.legendary: Lit a weather forecast so brightly that the real sun came out the next day just to compete.

lore.common: Has a switch that nobody can ever find in the dark.
lore.uncommon: Hums one quiet note all evening, and everyone who walks down the hall ends up humming it too.
lore.rare: Switches on at the exact moment someone sneaks downstairs for a midnight biscuit.
lore.epic: Flickered so spookily in the old hotel corridor that the guests checked out and a ghost checked in.
lore.legendary: Welcomed visitors so warmly that the postman moved into the hallway, and now gets his own letters there.

lore.common: Creaks its handle back and forth with every step.
lore.uncommon: Has a little flame that wobbles in the breeze.
lore.rare: Throws its carrier's shadow ten times bigger, so every night walk meets a wobbly giant on the hedge.
lore.epic: Was held up on the school night walk, and every moth in the forest followed the class back onto the coach.
lore.legendary: Shone so steadily one winter night that the Moon took the evening off and nobody noticed.

lore.common: Pops at the worst moment and leaves you in the dark.
lore.uncommon: Buzzes quietly when it's tired.
lore.rare: Lights up over the head of anyone with an idea, so nobody in the house can keep a surprise secret.
lore.epic: Popped during the school play, so the cast finished it in the dark doing every sound effect with their mouths.
lore.legendary: Had such a bright idea that it invented a lamp, then a lighthouse, then a very small sun for the garden shed.

lore.common: Has one dead pixel right in the middle of the screen.
lore.uncommon: Tilts forward slowly over the day, and you have to push it back.
lore.rare: Glowed so brightly at night that its owner saw squares when they closed their eyes.
lore.epic: Showed the boss's screensaver on the big meeting screen, and the whole office found out he collects garden gnomes.
lore.legendary: Had so many windows open that one let in a real breeze, and the office switched its fans off for the summer.

lore.common: Shows everything in grainy grey so nobody can tell who's who.
lore.uncommon: Splits its screen into sixteen tiny boxes.
lore.rare: Shows a different room from the one its camera points at, so the guard has watched the staff kitchen all night.
lore.epic: Showed one pigeon on every screen at once, and the guards spent the night chasing a single bird round the shopping centre.
lore.legendary: Stared at one parked car so hard all night that the car got nervous and quietly moved itself to the next street.

lore.common: Spins its click wheel so fast that you whizz straight past the song you wanted.
lore.uncommon: Comes out of every pocket with its earbuds tied in a knot.
lore.rare: Shuffles to the most embarrassing song the moment its headphones fall out on the bus.
lore.epic: Got plugged into the school speakers by mistake, and the fire drill happened to a disco remix.
lore.legendary: Fitted so many songs in such a small box that a whole brass band climbed out when it was opened.

lore.common: Clips onto your sleeve and gets lost in the washing machine.
lore.uncommon: Is so small that people keep mistaking it for a stick of chewing gum.
lore.rare: Plays songs with exactly the wrong beat, so its jogger ends up skipping like a lamb.
lore.epic: Played a march so loudly at the fun run that every runner finished in step, including a dog that wasn't in the race.
lore.legendary: Went through the washing machine so many times that every song now comes out with bubbles in it.

lore.common: Sips its battery so slowly that nobody remembers to charge it.
lore.uncommon: Puts one song on repeat until you hear it in your dreams.
lore.rare: Slips one song its owner has never heard into every playlist, and it's always a sea shanty.
lore.epic: Played the whole road trip mixtape, and the family sang along for eight hours.
lore.legendary: Played one road-trip song so often that the car learned to sing it, and now hums along at traffic lights.

lore.common: Whirrs its fan so loudly that the teacher has to shout.
lore.uncommon: Shows every sheet upside down the first time.
lore.rare: Made a giant shadow of the teacher's hand on the wall, and the class made it into a rabbit.
lore.epic: Melted a sheet during the lesson, so the whole class learned a map of a country shaped like a sock.
lore.legendary: Projected a sum so big across the school hall that next year's class is still solving it.

lore.common: Is always slightly out of focus no matter how much you twist the knob.
lore.uncommon: Shows every speck of dust floating in its beam.
lore.rare: Shows every film a little too big, so the hero's head is on the ceiling and his feet are in the kitchen.
lore.epic: Shone a shark film onto the neighbour's swimming pool, and nobody swam in it all summer.
lore.legendary: Projected a sunrise onto the clouds so convincingly that the whole town got up two hours early.

lore.common: Gets so hot that nobody dares touch it for an hour after.
lore.uncommon: Pops just before the big presentation, every time.
lore.rare: Shines so brightly that the shadow of one passing fly fills the whole cinema screen.
lore.epic: Blew during the big film premiere, so the actors had to stand up and perform the ending live.
lore.legendary: Shone its beam out of the cinema window so far that the next town watched the film on its clouds for free.

lore.common: Clacks so loudly between every slide that everyone jumps.
lore.uncommon: Always shows one slide upside down, and grandad pretends it's on purpose.
lore.rare: Slips one embarrassing slide into every show, usually Dad in his swimming trunks.
lore.epic: Jammed during the holiday show, so the family stared at a picture of one goat for the rest of the evening.
lore.legendary: Showed a beach holiday so vividly on the living-room wall that the family came back from the sofa with suntans.

lore.common: Has a snooze button that gets pressed ten times every morning.
lore.uncommon: Wakes you up with the wrong radio station every day.
lore.rare: Blared so loudly that it woke up the whole house and the neighbours.
lore.epic: Tuned itself to a cooking show at six in the morning, and the whole family woke up starving and making pancakes.
lore.legendary: Woke up a bear hibernating in the garden shed, and the bear asked for five more minutes.

lore.common: Pokes its aerial into everyone's eye at the picnic.
lore.uncommon: Plays music on the beach so loudly that seagulls fly over to listen.
lore.rare: Picks up the phone calls from next door between songs, so the whole picnic hears about Auntie's bunions.
lore.epic: Lost its signal halfway through the big match, so the whole beach had to make up the score.
lore.legendary: Picked up a station so far away that it played next year's music, and the family already knows the summer hit.

lore.common: Crackles between stations so loudly that the dog howls.
lore.uncommon: Talks all day long in the kitchen, even when nobody is listening.
lore.rare: Changes station by itself the moment anyone starts to sing along.
lore.epic: Read out the weather so gloomily that the sun went back in, and the street barbecue was rained off.
lore.legendary: Tuned in so carefully that it found a station run entirely by hedgehogs, and their quiz is very hard.

lore.common: Gets chewed by the tape player and spills ribbon everywhere.
lore.uncommon: Has to be wound back with a pencil when the tape comes loose.
lore.rare: Slows every song down when its batteries get low, so the party ends in one long sleepy yawn.
lore.epic: Was flipped to side B on the coach, and side B turned out to be Dad practising the bagpipes.
lore.legendary: Was rewound with a pencil so fast that it went back in time and recorded a dinosaur.

lore.common: Hums and buzzes even when nobody is playing.
lore.uncommon: Has a little red light that glows when it's warm and ready to roar.
lore.rare: Screeched with feedback so loudly that the cat left the house.
lore.epic: Was turned up so loud at band practice that the garage door opened by itself and the car rolled out to escape.
lore.legendary: Played one chord so loud that it was still echoing round the valley a year later, and the sheep had learned it.

lore.common: Makes everyone sing off-key, even the good singers.
lore.uncommon: Gives a round of fake applause after every song, even the terrible ones.
lore.rare: Showed the lyrics so fast that everybody sang a different word at the same time.
lore.epic: Gave the cat a perfect score, so the whole party had to sit through an encore of meowing.
lore.legendary: Scored Grandad's singing so highly that he believed it, and he now tours every village hall in the county.

lore.common: Rumbles the bass so hard that the popcorn bounces in the bowl.
lore.uncommon: Makes every whisper on TV sound like it's coming from behind the sofa.
lore.rare: Makes every actor mumble, and then shouts every explosion.
lore.epic: Rumbled the whole house during the action film, and the pictures fell off the wall.
lore.legendary: Played a film earthquake so realistically that the dog next door dug itself a shelter in the garden.

lore.common: Rattles the shelf with every bass note.
lore.uncommon: Beeps loudly every time it connects, usually at midnight.
lore.rare: Plays from whichever phone is nearest, so the party music keeps turning into Grandma's voicemail.
lore.epic: Was turned up for the street party and made every car alarm on the road join in with the chorus.
lore.legendary: Was left playing in a lost suitcase and led the airport staff straight to it by the sound of the drums.

names.legendary: Coach Shoutwell of the Playing Field

lore.common: Blasts in the ear of whoever is standing in front of it.
lore.uncommon: Squawks and whistles every time it's switched on.
lore.rare: Turns every whisper into a shout, so the whole school knows everybody's secrets by lunch.
lore.epic: Announced the egg-and-spoon race so loudly that every egg in the box cracked at once.
lore.legendary: Shouted LUNCH across the playing fields so loudly that the school in the next town came too.

lore.common: Blasts its horn so loudly that the seagulls scatter.
lore.uncommon: Turns every voice into a robot's, so the lifeguard sounds like a toaster.
lore.rare: Calls so loudly across the beach that the tide comes in early to see what the fuss is about.
lore.epic: Announced the ice-cream van so loudly that every boat in the harbour raced back to the beach.
lore.legendary: Honked so loudly from the pier that a passing ferry honked back, and the two have been best friends ever since.

lore.common: Has a joystick that sticks to the left at the worst moment.
lore.uncommon: Has had the same name at the top of its high score list for ten years.
lore.rare: Spat out a whole roll of prize tickets when someone finally beat the record.
lore.epic: Let a seagull beat the high score, and now every seagull on the pier demands a go.
lore.legendary: Was played so well by one grandma that the game ran out of levels and had to invent a new one just for her.

lore.common: Makes everyone forget their PIN the moment they reach the front.
lore.uncommon: Rolls out a paper receipt so long that it trails along the pavement.
lore.rare: Pays out in the smallest coins when it's grumpy, so everyone leaves jingling like a piggy bank.
lore.epic: Gave everyone a receipt instead of money on fair day, so the whole fair was paid for in paper slips.
lore.legendary: Paid out a whole bag of coins to a squirrel by mistake, and the squirrel now owns a very fancy nest.

lore.common: Plays the same song over and over because someone keeps choosing it.
lore.uncommon: Glows in neon colours in the corner of the diner.
lore.rare: Swallows coins and plays whatever it likes, which is always a song about a lonely cowboy.
lore.epic: Got everyone in the diner dancing on the tables.
lore.legendary: Played one record so many times that the record learned to play itself, and the jukebox now just watches.

lore.common: Takes the photo just as you're sitting down.
lore.uncommon: Flashes four times so fast that everyone ends up with their eyes closed.
lore.rare: Squeezes one extra person into every photo strip, and nobody ever knows who they are.
lore.epic: Had a queue all night at the wedding, and every guest came out with a strip of silly faces.
lore.legendary: Fitted a whole football team, the referee and the mascot into one tiny booth, and printed them all on one strip.

lore.common: Has a lever that every child pulls on the way past.
lore.uncommon: Spins its pictures of cherries and lemons until everyone gets dizzy.
lore.rare: Makes three cherries line up on everything nearby, so the fruit bowl now holds nothing but cherries.
lore.epic: Had its lever pulled by a passing beach donkey, and the donkey got three lemons and looked very sour.
lore.legendary: Spun its reels so fast that it launched a cherry into the sky, and the cherry still circles the pier at teatime.

lore.common: Takes ages to print a ticket while the train pulls in.
lore.uncommon: Refuses every coin that's a bit bent.
lore.rare: Prints tickets to stations that don't exist, and the passengers somehow get there anyway.
lore.epic: Printed one ticket so long that the conductor had to check it carriage by carriage.
lore.legendary: Sold a ticket to somewhere so far away that the train is still going, and it sends a postcard every year.

lore.common: Gets your snack stuck halfway down every single time.
lore.uncommon: Has a touch screen that needs tapping five times.
lore.rare: Made a coffee and forgot the cup.
lore.epic: Dropped every snack at once when someone thumped it, and the office ate crisps for lunch all week.
lore.legendary: Gave out a free can every time a sad face looked into its glass, and the office became the happiest in town.

lore.common: Gets mounted to a helmet and films only the sky.
lore.uncommon: Survives every splash, puddle and dunk in the river.
lore.rare: Sticks to anything that moves, so the family's best holiday film was shot from the back of a seagull.
lore.epic: Filmed the whole mountain bike race from the front, and the video made everyone dizzy.
lore.legendary: Was stuck to a tortoise for a whole year and made the slowest, most popular adventure film ever.

lore.common: Crackles so loudly that the parents think the baby is crying.
lore.uncommon: Records every snore, sigh and giggle from the nursery.
lore.rare: Picks up the baby next door instead, so the parents rush in to comfort a cot that is already fast asleep.
lore.epic: Played one tiny snore through the house so loudly that the whole family got dressed for school at midnight.
lore.legendary: Played a lullaby back so softly that both parents fell asleep, and the baby had to switch the monitor off.

lore.common: Goes in the wrong way round every time, even though there is a little picture showing how.
lore.uncommon: Lives in the kitchen drawer with fifty others, half of them flat and all of them pretending not to be.
lore.rare: Swaps places with a dead battery in the drawer every night, so nobody ever knows which is which.
lore.epic: Was put in backwards, so the robot dog walked backwards round the birthday party for an hour.
lore.legendary: Powered a clock so well that the clock ran on into next week, and the family is now always early.

lore.common: Drips wax all over the tablecloth.
lore.uncommon: Holds five candles that never burn down at the same speed.
lore.rare: Made shadows dance across the walls of the old castle hall.
lore.epic: Dripped so much wax at the banquet that the roast chicken came out wearing a little candle hat.
lore.legendary: Kept five flames so steady in a gale that the castle flag blew away and the candles did not even flicker.

lore.common: Collects a puddle of wax that sets hard and never comes out.
lore.uncommon: Tilts its candle sideways so it burns down crooked.
lore.rare: Makes its candle lean sideways, so every shadow in the room looks like it's in a hurry.
lore.epic: Held so many candles on Grandad's cake that the smoke alarm sang along before anyone else did.
lore.legendary: Kept a candle burning so slowly that it took all winter to melt one inch, and spring arrived to find it still going.

lore.common: Gets its tape tangled in the car player, and the song comes out sounding underwater.
lore.uncommon: Has to be flipped over halfway through the album.
lore.rare: Records over the best bit of everything, so Grandad's birthday message now ends with the weather forecast.
lore.epic: Was taped from the radio with the DJ talking over every song, so the whole class sang the DJ's words at the school concert.
lore.legendary: Recorded a secret message so clearly that the whole town played it backwards, and it said please tidy your room.

lore.common: Skips on the best song because of one tiny scratch.
lore.uncommon: Shines rainbows across the room when it catches the light.
lore.rare: Was used as a coaster so often that it forgot it was music.
lore.epic: Was hung in the garden to scare the birds, and every magpie in town came to dance in its rainbows.
lore.legendary: Spun out of the car window so fast that it went round the roundabout and flew back in.

lore.common: Clunks loudly every time it changes disc.
lore.uncommon: Shuffles between five albums so often that the family argues about which one is on.
lore.rare: Swaps the disc halfway through a song, so every chorus belongs to a different band.
lore.epic: Got stuck between two discs at the party, and the guests danced to a lullaby and a brass band at once.
lore.legendary: Shuffled its five discs so cleverly that it invented a sixth album that nobody ever bought.

lore.common: Frays at the end so it only works if you hold it at a certain angle.
lore.uncommon: Never fits the gadget you actually need to charge.
lore.rare: Tangles itself round every other cable on the bedside table.
lore.epic: Was the only charger in the house, so the whole family queued for it.
lore.legendary: Was borrowed so often that it has visited more countries than its owner, and has the luggage stickers to prove it.

lore.common: Stares out of the windscreen all day and records forty hours of nothing much.
lore.uncommon: Slips off the glass on every bump, then films the car floor until someone notices.
lore.rare: Settles every back-seat argument by replaying exactly who poked whom first.
lore.epic: Filmed a goose chasing a postman for a whole mile, and the clip played on the evening news.
lore.legendary: Recorded a meteor so clearly that scientists came to borrow the car.

lore.common: Rings while you're in the bath, and the doorstep is always empty.
lore.uncommon: Plays a tune so slowly that the visitor has gone before it finishes.
lore.rare: Rings itself whenever a parcel is near, even when the van is three streets away.
lore.epic: Played its tune at every house in the street at once, and the neighbours all opened their doors to each other.
lore.legendary: Was pressed by a lost hedgehog, a fox and a grandma on the same night, and welcomed them all.

lore.common: Gets fingerprints all over it the moment it leaves its box.
lore.uncommon: Plays the menu music over and over while everyone looks for the remote.
lore.rare: Freezes the film on a funny face and refuses to move on.
lore.epic: Had a bonus feature longer than the film, and the family is still watching the bloopers.
lore.legendary: Was watched so many times that the actors started waving at the family.

lore.common: Lies across the doorway exactly where everyone trips on it.
lore.uncommon: Tangles itself into a knot the moment it's put away.
lore.rare: Stretched from the kitchen to the bottom of the garden, just to power one fairy light.
lore.epic: Was plugged into another cord, then another, until the whole street was running off one kitchen socket.
lore.legendary: Was unrolled for the village fair and reached so far that it powered the bouncy castle in the next village.

lore.common: Screams every time someone makes toast, even when it's not burnt.
lore.uncommon: Chirps at three in the morning to say its battery is low.
lore.rare: Tells on anyone who has a steamy shower without opening the window.
lore.epic: Went off during the school play, and the whole audience finished watching it in the playground.
lore.legendary: Woke a whole house in time, and the family gave it a tiny birthday cake every year after.

lore.common: Stands in the corner for years without anyone ever touching it.
lore.uncommon: Has a pin that everyone is told never, ever to pull.
lore.rare: Covered a small kitchen fire in foam so fast that the toast was saved too.
lore.epic: Was set off by mistake at the safety demo, and the whole car park turned into a bubble bath.
lore.legendary: Foamed a barbecue so thoroughly that the sausages came out tasting of lemon meringue.

lore.common: Dangles its little hose where it catches on every passing coat.
lore.uncommon: Has a little gauge that everyone taps to check the needle.
lore.rare: Sneezes a puff of white powder whenever someone mentions candles, so birthday parties come out very white.
lore.epic: Went off in the workshop during the drill, and everyone came out looking like snowmen.
lore.legendary: Put out a bonfire that got too big at the village fete, and was given the front seat in the parade.

lore.common: Sits in the torch looking full, then gives up the moment you step outside in the dark.
lore.uncommon: Rolls into the gap behind the sofa the moment the torch is opened.
lore.rare: Hops out of the torch whenever a spider appears, and leaves its owner alone in the dark with it.
lore.epic: Ran out at the campfire story just as someone shouted BOO, and three tents fell down from the jump.
lore.legendary: Powered a torch for so long that the torch retired first, and the battery took a new job in the doorbell.

lore.common: Rolls off the table and points straight in your eyes every time you go to pick it up.
lore.uncommon: Gets shone under your chin to make your face spooky.
lore.rare: Shines its beam on the ceiling and turns a bedtime story into a shadow-puppet show.
lore.epic: Lit up a ghost story at camp so spookily that everyone slept in one tent.
lore.legendary: Shone so bravely into the cupboard under the stairs that the monster living there moved out and left a thank-you note.

lore.common: Has a metal shutter that everyone slides back and forth to fidget.
lore.uncommon: Looks exactly like the save button, and children think it's a 3D print of it.
lore.rare: Held one tiny file and made a huge clunk saving it.
lore.epic: Clunked in every computer in the classroom at once, and the room sounded like a tap dance.
lore.legendary: Held a game so tiny that its characters climbed out at night to stretch their legs.

lore.common: Lives in a dark cupboard under the stairs where nobody can find the torch.
lore.uncommon: Trips its switch whenever the kettle and the toaster are on together.
lore.rare: Popped a fuse during a film and left the family sitting in the dark.
lore.epic: Tripped during the big dinner party, and everyone finished eating by candlelight.
lore.legendary: Saved a whole house from a faulty toaster, and the toaster has been in disgrace ever since.

lore.common: Snaps with a crack that makes everyone jump.
lore.uncommon: Glows brightly at first, then fades before the party is over.
lore.rare: Glows so brightly in the dark that the fish in the pond swim up to look.
lore.epic: Was dropped into the school swimming pool, and the swimming lesson turned into a glowing disco.
lore.legendary: Glowed so green at the bottom of the garden that the neighbours reported a tiny alien landing.

lore.common: Blinds everyone you turn to talk to.
lore.uncommon: Squeezes your head so tightly that it leaves a line on your forehead.
lore.rare: Lit up a whole cave while both hands were busy holding sandwiches.
lore.epic: Was worn backwards on the school camping trip, so the whole class followed their teacher's head the wrong way to the toilets.
lore.legendary: Lit a caver's way through a mountain from one side to the other, and came out with a bat on top.

names.legendary: Buzzwell, Voice of the Front Door

lore.common: Crackles so badly that every visitor sounds like a robot.
lore.uncommon: Buzzes the door open just as you've let go of it.
lore.rare: Mixes up who is calling, so the pizza driver gets invited in for Grandma's tea.
lore.epic: Connected every flat in the building at once by mistake, and all the neighbours chatted for an hour.
lore.legendary: Crackled so badly that one visitor's hello came out as a perfect opera song, and the whole building clapped.

lore.common: Swings so much on its handle that the light makes everyone seasick.
lore.uncommon: Is carried along the field paths at night like a little moon.
lore.rare: Swings its light so hypnotically that whoever carries it walks in circles until morning.
lore.epic: Was swung so hard at the harvest parade that the whole village followed it straight into the duck pond.
lore.legendary: Swung so far on its handle that it went right round the world and came back from the other side.

lore.common: Takes an hour to warm up, then everyone watches it instead of the TV.
lore.uncommon: Has slow blobs that float up and down, up and down.
lore.rare: Hypnotised the cat so completely that it sat still for a whole afternoon.
lore.epic: Made a whole party sit and stare at it in silence until midnight.
lore.legendary: Bubbled so slowly that one blob took a whole year to rise, and the family threw it a party when it reached the top.

names.legendary: Strobina, Queen of the Night Road

lore.common: Flashes so brightly on the car roof that the houses turn blue for a second.
lore.uncommon: Blinks in a pattern that everyone tries to count.
lore.rare: Strobed so fast that it made the trees look like they were dancing.
lore.epic: Flashed so fast at the road-safety day that the lollipop lady started directing traffic with disco moves.
lore.legendary: Flashed so brightly in a traffic jam that every car shuffled aside to let the ice-cream van through first.

lore.common: Buzzes like a fly and flickers its first letter on and off.
lore.uncommon: Has one letter that doesn't work, so the diner's name spells something silly.
lore.rare: Glows so pink that everyone standing under it looks like they're blushing.
lore.epic: Flickered its arrow so wildly one night that the delivery vans all tried to park on the diner roof.
lore.legendary: Glowed so pink one night that the moon blushed too, and it has looked a little pink ever since.

lore.common: Glows so dimly that the corner looks scarier than without it.
lore.uncommon: Has a button that goes from dim to dimmer.
lore.rare: Chased every monster out from under the bed, according to its small owner.
lore.epic: Glowed so cosily during a thunderstorm that the thunder curled up on the landing and fell asleep too.
lore.legendary: Glowed so bravely that the monster under the bed moved out, and now sends a postcard from the seaside every summer.

lore.common: Puffs black smoke if the wick is turned up too high.
lore.uncommon: Covers its glass in soot that has to be cleaned every morning.
lore.rare: Lit the whole barn so warmly that the cows thought it was spring.
lore.epic: Puffed so much soot at the barn dance that everyone went home looking like chimney sweeps.
lore.legendary: Burned on one drop of oil all winter, and the barn owl did its homework under it every night.

lore.common: Gets a tiny tear in its paper the first time anyone touches it.
lore.uncommon: Glows so softly that it looks like a little moon in the garden.
lore.rare: Glows brighter whenever someone in the room tells a fib, which makes birthday surprises very hard.
lore.epic: Blew off its string at the garden party and bounced down the street, and the whole party chased it to the bus stop.
lore.legendary: Glowed so softly that a family of fireflies moved in, and now it never needs switching on.

lore.common: Has one pin that's slightly bent, so it never goes in first time.
lore.uncommon: Lies upside down on the floor so that you step on it barefoot.
lore.rare: Stuck in the socket so tightly that it took two people to pull it out.
lore.epic: Was pulled out by mistake during the bake-off, so every cake in the oven came out exactly half baked.
lore.legendary: Was plugged in so firmly that when the family moved house, they had to take the wall with them.

lore.common: Weighs down your pocket like a brick.
lore.uncommon: Is always half charged when you need it most.
lore.rare: Charges every phone in the room except its owner's, which it pretends not to see.
lore.epic: Was lent to a friend at the festival, then to their friend, then theirs, and came home three weeks later with a tan.
lore.legendary: Charged a phone so full that the phone started charging the power bank back, and they've argued about it ever since.

lore.common: Has every socket full, so there's never room for your charger.
lore.uncommon: Has a little red switch that someone always flicks off by mistake.
lore.rare: Got so overloaded that its switch popped and everything went dark.
lore.epic: Powered every gadget in the bedroom, and the cables looked like spaghetti.
lore.legendary: Grew a new socket every time someone needed one, and now stretches round the whole room like a snake.

lore.common: Clicks against the spokes of the bike wheel with every turn.
lore.uncommon: Catches the headlights of every car so brightly that it blinks back.
lore.rare: Shines back so brightly that every cat on the wall stops to stare at it all night.
lore.epic: Caught the headlights so well on the night ride that every car slowed down just to wave at the bikes.
lore.legendary: Shone back at a lighthouse so brightly that the lighthouse thought it had a twin, and they still blink at each other every night.

lore.common: Glows so dimly that every guest asks if it is switched on, and then pokes it to check.
lore.uncommon: Feels a little damp on rainy days, because salt loves to soak up water.
lore.rare: Made a busy room feel so calm that everyone started whispering.
lore.epic: Calmed the staff meeting so much that nobody could remember what they were arguing about, and lunch started early.
lore.legendary: Soaked up so much damp on one rainy day that the whole street's washing dried at once.

lore.common: Clicks off with a loud clunk the moment the song gets good, and never during the boring bit.
lore.uncommon: Has two decks for copying one tape onto another.
lore.rare: Copied one tape onto another so many times that the last copy sounded like it was sung underwater.
lore.epic: Played the school concert recording at double speed, and the parents clapped twice as fast to keep up.
lore.legendary: Made a mixtape so good that the songs on it met up and started a band together.

lore.common: Gets turned up by one person and down by another all day.
lore.uncommon: Clicks every time the heating turns on.
lore.rare: Sets itself to tropical whenever nobody is looking, so the houseplants have started growing bananas.
lore.epic: Was turned up so high at the winter party that the snowman in the garden came inside for a cold drink.
lore.legendary: Turned the heating so high one winter that spring came early to the whole street, and the daffodils were furious.

lore.common: Needs shaking every few minutes to keep working.
lore.uncommon: Shines on the wall to make shadow puppets.
lore.rare: Finds every spider in the garden at night and shines on it until everyone screams.
lore.epic: Lit up the whole campsite search for a lost teddy, and the teddy was found in a tree.
lore.legendary: Shone up so hard one night that it wrote its name on a cloud, and the cloud still spells it at sunset.

lore.common: Gets a tiny scratch that makes it jump every time the chorus comes.
lore.uncommon: Wobbles on its spindle like a spinning plate.
lore.rare: Warps in the sun until every song on it sounds seasick, even the lullabies.
lore.epic: Was skimmed across the picnic like a flying saucer, and landed on the fair's record player still playing.
lore.legendary: Has one groove so long that its last song has never finished, and the family plans holidays around it.

lore.common: Films only the inside of your nose unless you hold it just right.
lore.uncommon: Freezes your face mid-sneeze for everyone on the call to see.
lore.rare: Showed the cat walking across the keyboard during the big meeting.
lore.epic: Turned on a cat filter during the head teacher's online assembly, and the whole school was led by a kitten for an hour.
lore.legendary: Lagged so far behind that it showed last Tuesday's meeting instead, and everyone agreed it went much better.

lore.common: Charges the phone only if it's placed in exactly the right spot.
lore.uncommon: Lets the phone slide off its pad at night.
lore.rare: Pulls phones across the bedside table towards it like a magnet, and the glass of water too.
lore.epic: Charged the sleepover's phones so slowly that everyone had to talk to each other all night.
lore.legendary: Was left in a sunny window, charged a lost bee that landed on it, and the bee now visits every morning.
